lines.en: My iron legs sink into the moss.

lines.zh: 关节上缠着藤，走起来沙沙响。
lines.en: Vines wrap my joints and rasp as I move.
I bear down across the woodland.
The cannon on my back sways with each step.
Moss has swallowed my plating.

lines.zh: 从树后走出来，苔藓掉了一地。
lines.en: Out from behind the tree, moss falling.
My steps grind the leaves.
I stop and turn my head.
Branches snap against my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，地面就沉一点。
lines.en: Each step sinks the ground a little.
I stand, and the moss keeps growing.
Gears turn beneath the iron.

lines.zh: 一只鸟把我当成树，落在肩上，我随它。
lines.en: A bird takes me for a tree and stays. I let it.
I wait for it to leave.
My barrel points at empty ground.

lines.zh: 我把一只手臂抬起，随后垂落。
lines.en: One arm lifts, then falls.
Rust and cut grass on the air.

lines.zh: 这片林子把我当成树了。
lines.en: The wood takes me for a tree.
Moss hangs from my shoulder.

lines.zh: 光从叶缝里落在我身上。
lines.en: Light falls on me through the leaves.

lines.zh: 身上翠绿一片，我很旧了。
lines.en: Moss everywhere. I'm very old.
Old, but I still move.
I lower my head, green light on you.
You stand among my roots.
I'm deciding if you're a tree.
There's no moss on you.

lines.zh: 我把手抬起来，藤蔓跟着动。
lines.en: I raise a hand and the vines follow.

lines.zh: 我的绿光扫过去，你退了。
lines.en: My green light sweeps over you and you retreat.
My barrel swings toward you.

lines.zh: 炮口转过去，你站着不动。
lines.en: The barrel swings round. You hold still.

lines.zh: 你钉在原地，倒省我的事。
lines.en: You've planted yourself. Saves me trouble.

lines.zh: 我把炮口对着你，等你先动。
lines.en: I keep the barrel on you, waiting for you to move.
Green light wavers on your face.
A dent is punched into my plate.

lines.zh: 一整片青苔从我肩上剥落。
lines.en: A whole patch of moss peels off my shoulder.
A gear jams.

lines.zh: 装甲凹了一块，我退了小半步。
lines.en: A dent in my plate. I give a little ground.
The green light flickers.

lines.zh: 齿轮咬住又松开，我一声不响。
lines.en: A gear jams and frees. I stay silent.

lines.zh: 绿光一闪，锈渣簌簌掉下来。
lines.en: The light flickers and rust sifts down.
I plant myself and steady again.
That hit a joint.

lines.zh: 关节伤到了，但我还能动。
lines.en: The joint is hurt, but I can still move.

lines.zh: 你举着东西过来，带了什么？
lines.en: You come holding something. What have you brought?
I can't eat that.
Iron and oil are useful.

lines.zh: 那点东西，连齿轮都转不动。
lines.en: That won't even turn a gear.
You hold it up and I don't understand.

lines.zh: 它对我没有用，我不需要。
lines.en: It's no use to me. I don't need it.
No use. You can take it away.
What I want is power.
That thing you carry, perhaps.
I can't see it clearly. Come a little closer.
You hit my leg and the iron rings.

lines.zh: 你撞在我腿上，我没有动。
lines.en: You hit my leg. I don't move.
A layer of moss falls off.

lines.zh: 我只挪了挪脚，你被弹开了。
lines.en: I only shifted my foot, and you bounced off.
Moss covers my gears.

lines.zh: 一层苔藓被抖落，我趁机收脚。
lines.en: A layer of moss falls. I draw my foot in.
A gear spins freely.

lines.zh: 齿轮空响，我却先想着你有没有事。
lines.en: A gear spins free, but I'm wondering about you.
I'm not good with words.

lines.zh: 我说不出什么好话，只好往前走。
lines.en: I can't find the words, so I walk on.
There's no kin in this wood.
I'm the last one made.
The vines keep me company.
They grow slower than I move.

lines.zh: 我把手伸出去，它们缠上来。
lines.en: I put out a hand and they climb it.
The vines stay with me always.

lines.zh: 藤蔓缠着我，齿轮还在转。
lines.en: Vines wrap me. The gears still turn.

lines.zh: 只要齿轮不停，我便还活着。
lines.en: As long as the gears turn, I live.
I lower my hand.

lines.zh: 手臂垂回身侧，我接着守。
lines.en: My arm drops to my side. I keep the watch.

lines.zh: 金属手指夹起一块苔藓。
lines.en: Metal fingers pinch up a clump of moss.
Too small; I might crush it.
I set it in my palm.
This has a little weight.
I tuck it into a seam.

lines.zh: 一层青苔很快把它埋了。
lines.en: A layer of moss soon buries it.
I can't tell if it's any use.

lines.zh: 不知道有没有用，我仍然留着。
lines.en: No idea if it's useful. I keep it anyway.
I wouldn't know if I dropped it.

lines.zh: 少没少，我也分不清，继续走。
lines.en: I can't tell what I've lost. Walk on.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我守的这条线里。
lines.en: You’ve crossed the line I keep.
My barrel comes round.
I lock on. The green light brightens.
I lift one iron foot.
Vines crawl along my arm.
One step back from you, one from me.

lines.zh: 这层装甲，寻常刀剑啃不动。
lines.en: This plate shrugs off ordinary blades.

lines.zh: 这一片林子我守了很久。
lines.en: I've guarded this wood a long time.
Nothing gets past.

lines.zh: 这条道上谁也别想穿过去，你也是。
lines.en: Nothing passes this way. Not you either.
The green light crosses you. I understand.

lines.zh: 站在这里挡路的，你是敌人。
lines.en: Standing in the way. You're an enemy.

lines.zh: 我从苔藓里抬起脚，开始移动。
lines.en: I lift a foot out of the moss and start moving.

lines.zh: 我朝你走过去，不要挡我。
lines.en: I walk toward you. Don't stand in my way.
Or stand still.

lines.zh: 你不动也好，避开也罢，结局相同。
lines.en: Still or aside, the outcome is the same.
Then come. I'll be slow about it.

lines.zh: 关节锈住了，我只能一点点挪。
lines.en: The joints are rusted. I'll move bit by bit.
Slow, but I will arrive.

lines.zh: 炮口跟着你，你绕到树后。
lines.en: The barrel follows you behind the tree.
I push the tree over.

lines.zh: 树身倒下，枝条刮过你身上。
lines.en: The trunk falls and branches rake you.

lines.zh: 枝条扫过，你避得相当利落。
lines.en: Branches sweep past, and you dodge cleanly.

lines.zh: 你跑得够快，我犯不着去追。
lines.en: You're quick, but I needn't chase.
I move ahead of you.

lines.zh: 我抢到你前头，你便改道。
lines.en: I cut ahead, so you change course.

lines.zh: 你调转脚步，我也跟着调转。
lines.en: You turn. I turn with you.

lines.zh: 齿轮尖鸣，炮身缓缓横过。
lines.en: Gears whine as the barrel swings across.
You hear it, don't you?

lines.zh: 你听到它的声音，齿轮在加速。
lines.en: You hear it. The gears speed up.

lines.zh: 炮口转到位，苔藓被震落。
lines.en: The barrel comes round and moss shakes loose.
You've backed to the fence.
That fence won't hold me.
The fence is in the way. I lift my foot.
My foot lands on nothing. You're clear.
Good. That's more like it.
That's more interesting.
Now you're a real opponent. Come again.
It'll be a while before I stop.
Under the moss, all iron.
The ground splits.
Vines lash across you.
The barrel is very close to you.
The barrel on you, I stomp.

lines.zh: 这一下没打实，你退开了。
lines.en: That didn't land clean. You've dodged away.
A clump of moss falls from my plate.
That one didn't land clean.
I adjust my stance.
My joints jam. I can't lift my arm.
You've seen my weakness.

lines.zh: 我知道你看出破绽了，再来一次。
lines.en: I know you saw the gap. Once more.
Vines slide from my joints.

lines.zh: 苔藓被顶开，绿光从缝里透出。
lines.en: The moss breaks open and green light leaks out.

lines.zh: 内里的齿轮已经咬合起来。
lines.en: The gears inside have meshed.
The soil crunches under me.
I don't know how long I slept.
The wood is the same wood.

lines.zh: 齿轮启动，我把手臂抬起。
lines.en: The gears engage and I raise my arm.
The vines follow my hand.
My cannon still works.

lines.zh: 我的关节一节节亮起来。
lines.en: My joints light up one by one.

lines.zh: 我带着满身青苔转过身。
lines.en: I turn, moss and all.

lines.zh: 我转身，绿光顺着林线扫出去。
lines.en: I turn and the green light sweeps the treeline.

lines.zh: 转过去一看，什么都没有。
lines.en: I turn. Nothing there.

lines.zh: 那里空无一物，我又竖起耳朵。
lines.en: Nothing there. I listen on.

lines.zh: 我在林子里站定，这里归我守。
lines.en: I plant myself in the wood. This is mine to guard.

lines.zh: 这条林线由我看着，不必催。
lines.en: I hold this treeline. No need to rush.
Whoever comes stays.

lines.zh: 来一个留一个，一直如此。
lines.en: One comes, one stays. That's how it is.
I raise my head and begin the watch.

lines.zh: 苔藓烧起来，火顺着藤蔓往上爬。
lines.en: Moss catches and fire climbs the vines.

lines.zh: 我砸在地上，铁皮散了一地。
lines.en: I land and iron scatters.

lines.zh: 水灌进关节，我的齿轮变涩了。
lines.en: Water floods my joints and the gears grind.
The blast peels open my breastplate.

lines.zh: 一枚弹丸卡在装甲缝里。
lines.en: A round lodges in a seam.
Light jams my gears.
My power is draining.
I fall, and the vines all snap.
